title: Evaluation of an affine subspace restriction
statement: Let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\alpha$ be a function, let $H$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb F_2^n$, let $z\in\mathbb F_2^n$, and let $h\in H$. The affine subspace restriction of $f$ at $h$ equals $f(h+z)$.
hypotheses_covered: $H$ is a linear subspace of $\mathbb F_2^n$
